name: hud_ui_mgr_register_at_exit
description: HudUiMgr::RegisterAtExit registers the global HUD manager atexit destructor callback.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The retail body is compiler-generated atexit registration glue and should be byte-checked with the HUD manager static lifecycle cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40d420 pushes 0x40d430 HudUiMgr::AtExitDestructor and calls the imported atexit provider.
Binary Ninja assembly for unplanned 0x40d430 validates it as a pure atexit callback thunk that loads g_HudUiMgr and tail-jumps to 0x40d440 HudUiMgr::StaticDestructor.
0x40d440 HudUiMgr::StaticDestructor is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_mgr_static_destructor.

The native register-at-exit smoke constructs the HUD manager, registers the callback, verifies the constructed lifecycle state, then tears down and clears the native harness object so the registered callback can run at process exit without double-destroying the C++ global wrapper.
